samples.question: The image shows nine square panels, each framed by a thin blue border, scattered across the field. Each panel holds one piece of a letter and carries a small blue dot near its lower edge whose left-to-right position marks that piece's place in the reassembly order. Reassemble the panels into a three-by-three grid: put the piece with the leftmost dot in the top-left cell, advancing left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Which letter, A or B, do the reassembled panels form? Answer A or B.
